known_secrets.text: The palace complex contains at least three distinct construction phases based on tool marks and material composition — timber, brick, and polished stone.
One phase predates the known building techniques of the settled town entirely.
Certain stone joints appear designed to allow controlled partial collapse rather than full stability.
This is not typical of defensive or ceremonial architecture.
Internal alignment patterns do not match the surface symmetry of the Great Hall.
These patterns suggest intentional internal structuring beneath the visible layers.
Some repairs may actually be sealing previously open access points.
I have not informed Balamitra of this interpretation.
